crossRefs.note: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then…
But he began to curse, and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”
The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows…
Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
translations.bsb: “Man, I do not know what you are talking about,” Peter replied. And immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
translations.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
translations.asv: But Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
